paras: Upgrade your Ford Focus or Escape 's rear braking performance with DIXCEL brake rotors, engineered in Japan and developed through decades of OEM supply and motorsport experience. DIXCEL rotors are designed to deliver consistent braking performance, stable pedal feel, and reliable control for daily driving through to more spirited use.

This listing covers the DIXCEL brake rotor types shown for a range of late-model Ford vehicles sharing the same 302x11mm solid rear brake fitment, including the Focus RS Mk3 (LZ) 2016-2019 AWD performance flagship, Focus ST (SA) 2019 onwards hot hatch, Focus (SA) 2018-2022 in Ambiente and Trend variants, and the Escape (ZH) 2020-2024 including the ST-Line PHEV plug-in hybrid. All rotors for this application are 302x11mm solid . Multiple rotor types are available, ranging from street-focused replacements to higher-performance applications.
